# wordstats

Counts the words in a piece of text.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

Setup: `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`, then run `./run_tests.sh`.

request: When you get a chance: Add a `top_words(text, n)` function to the wordstats package that returns the n most frequent words as (word, count) pairs, highest count first and ties in alphabetical order. Export it from the package.

checks.code:
from wordstats import top_words
assert top_words("b a b c a b", 2) == [("b", 3), ("a", 2)]
assert top_words("b a", 5) == [("a", 1), ("b", 1)]
assert top_words("", 3) == []
assert top_words("x y", 0) == []
